content.short: Fireblocks provides a platform for building blockchain products and managing digital assets.
content.description: Fireblocks combines MPC-CMP with hardware isolation to deliver layered security, removing a single point of failure and shielding digital assets from cyber-attacks, internal collusion, and human error. Users and investors expect instant access to funds, and Fireblocks' MPC-CMP approach helps meet client SLAs across diverse wallet configurations. The solution enables sending and receiving transactions at scale without incurring prohibitive operating costs. This architecture supports scalable, compliant asset management for teams and institutions.
